description: Bredbåndsabonnementer efter bredbåndstype is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Danmarks Statistik. StatBank dataset: DIS122 Title: Broadband subscriptions by type of broadband Type of period: semester Periodic format (time in data): yyyyhh The oldest period: 2000H2 Latest period: 2024H2. Coverage: Danmarks Statistik. The portal shows the English title as "Broadband subscriptions by type of broadband" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Danmarks Statistik. Its keywords include Videnskab og teknologi, Uddannelse, kultur og sport, Digital adfærd, Kultur og fritid, Digital adfærd og kulturvaner. The listing shows 5 download or service links in HTML, JSON, XML, CSV. The listing shows 2025-08-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
